sources.title: 四库本《文淵閣書目》卷三列字号题名
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/文淵閣書目總目_(四庫全書本)/全覽
sources.quality_notes: Lie first cabinet lists Ziwei Shu, Ziwei Zhenshu and Ziwei Qianjin Fu separately (one volume unit and one fascicle each), Ziping Yuanyuan ten fascicles and Tongbian Yuanyuan one fascicle. No missing labels in sampled lines and no physical original or working method from the entries.

sources.title: 识典《文淵閣書目》卷五列字号题名
sources.quality_notes: Separate Ziwei titles and two Yuanyuan entries with different fascicle counts. Tongbian uses 變 in this transcription, as opposed to 辯 in the Siku transcription. This is an index-level variant, exact original glyph and dependence unknown.

sources.title: 《讀畫齋叢書》国图影像索引所见题名和缺字
sources.provider: National Library of China source / Wikimedia Commons PDF
sources.url: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f3/NLC892-GBZX0301011631-283595_讀畫齋叢書_四十六種一百九十六卷_第38冊.pdf
sources.quality_notes: The machine-readable image index labels Ziwei Shu and Ziping Yuanyuan with 闕. No individual source-glyph inspection or determination of when missing labels were applied.

sources.title: 中国国家图书馆文淵閣转藏与杨士奇编目史说明
sources.quality_notes: Discusses transfer, the Zheng Tong inventory and the 1994 reproduction of the Duhuazhai edition. Supports archive context, not the individual natal title claims.

sources.title: 文淵閣書目完全、残缺、阙标注的年代分歧
sources.provider: Renmin University of China / Qing History Research Institute
sources.quality_notes: The review summarizes Zhang Sheng dating marks to Jiajing and Liu Ren dating them close to the 1605 inventory. Neither attribution is assumed for individual target titles.

sources.title: 莫旦《大明一統賦補》卷三紫微相关列目
sources.quality_notes: The received list includes Ziwei Zhenshu, Ziwei Qianjin Fu and Ziwei Shu. Two digital transcription routes show the list; neither is bound here to a precise original folio of the IHP or LoC copy.

sources.title: 傅斯年图书馆著录莫旦《大明一統賦補》弘治刊四卷
sources.provider: Academia Sinica IHP / Fu Ssu Nien Library
sources.quality_notes: Institutional catalog dates its edition to Hongzhi (1488–1505). Relevant juan-three text still needs direct binding to this impression.

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆《大明一統賦補》嘉靖翻刻与卷三影像
sources.provider: Library of Congress / Chinese Rare Book Collection
sources.quality_notes: Four juan in four image groups, catalog dates recut to 1541–1566; 1489 Zhao Kuan postface is earlier. Bibliographic note by Wang Chongmin posits a Wenyuange source for the juan-three catalog. The exact textual dependence is not adjudicated.

sources.title: 《書雲觀志》卷四〈書器〉《徐子平三命通變淵源》二卷
sources.quality_notes: Official text records two juan, attributed to Xu Dasheng, an excerpt of its preface, and blocks kept by the Observatory. No identification of surviving blocks or specific actual printed copy.

sources.title: 奎章阁《書雲觀志》奎57馆目与1818年序
sources.quality_notes: Institutional catalog gives dated preface by Seong Ju-deok and lists an additional Kyu 56 holding. Quoted Book Implements text is from the NIKH received transcript; image collation between holdings is not performed.

sources.title: 奎章阁《各道冊板目錄》奎7926及解题检索
sources.quality_notes: Catalog assigns 1840 and one fascicle with 34 leaves. The search result indexes Ziping Sanming Tongbian Yuanyuan by the Observatory title group. Exact original leaf and same-block identity unresolved.

sources.title: 韩国学中央研究院《实录辞典》徐子平书名和卷首说明
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies / Sillok Wiki
sources.quality_notes: Reports a Korean National Library copy with a Baoyou reign mark and Dongzhai Xu Dasheng preface attribution; uses 辯 in the title. This is an institutional explanatory article, not an item catalog or native glyph verification.

sources.title: RISS研究参考文献所引韩国国图本 한古朝19-104
sources.provider: Korea Education and Research Information Service / RISS
sources.quality_notes: Bibliography cites the National Library copy by title and shelfmark. The current first-party item record and folio have not been matched.

sources.title: 2019年김면수学位研究所述《通變淵源》卷上篇名
sources.provider: Korea Education and Research Information Service / RISS
sources.quality_notes: Research abstract reports Korean holdings and explicitly identifies Xiji and Jishan essays in the upper juan. Compare with the Qing record of the Li commentary, without adjudicating the stemma or copy date.

unresolved_lineage_questions: Which surviving catalog recension best identifies the title listings at the 1441 compilation layer and when were missing marks added?
Does either bound Hongzhi or Jiajing folio reproduce the same Ziwei title list, and what Ming catalog branch supplied the list?
Do title, rules or paratext connect the two Ming Yuanyuan entries, the Yuan commentary reported by the Qing, or the Joseon two-juan work?
Which issue of the Joseon work was printed from the Observatory boards, and how are the library copy and the Kyujanggak manuscript actually dated?
